description: This file defines the Font class responsible for parsing and interpreting font-related style information from XML elements in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles font attributes such as name, size, color, bold, italic, underline, and vertical alignment.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: A class for parsing font style attributes from XML and converting them into an internal style array.

methods.name: parseUnderline
methods.description: Parses the underline style attribute and updates the style array with the underline setting.

methods.name: parseVerticalAlign
methods.description: Parses vertical alignment attributes such as superscript and subscript from the style data.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Main method to parse the font style attributes from an XML element and return a styled array.
